about: Ars Technica (WordPress news site plus XenForo 'Civis' forum). The CLI reads article feeds by site, section, tag and author, fetches full articles, and reads forum threads and article comment threads.

commands.summary: List the newest articles across the whole site from the sitewide RSS feed (title, link, date, author, excerpt).
List the newest articles in a site section (e.g. gadgets, security, science) from the section RSS feed.

params.name: section
params.description: Section slug as it appears in article URLs, e.g. gadgets, security, science, ai, tech-policy, space, cars, gaming, culture, health, reviews

commands.summary: List articles with a given tag from the tag RSS feed. Items include the full article content.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag slug, lowercase and hyphenated, e.g. quantum-computing, cryptography, laptops

commands.summary: List the newest articles by one Ars Technica author from the author RSS feed.

params.name: author
params.description: Author slug from /author/{slug}/ URLs, e.g. dan-goodin

commands.summary: Fetch one article: title, description, author, publish date, body text and the link to its forum comment thread.

params.name: section
params.description: Section slug from the article URL, e.g. security, reviews, gadgets

params.name: month
params.description: 2-digit month from the article URL, e.g. 09

commands.summary: Read the posts in a forum thread, including an article's comment thread, one page at a time. Can sort by vote score.

params.name: thread
params.description: Thread slug plus numeric id, in the form slug.id. Taken from /civis/threads/{slug}.{id}/ URLs, e.g. the article's commentsUrl.

params.name: order
params.description: Post order. Omit for chronological; vote_score sorts by votes.

commands.summary: List threads in a forum, e.g. News Discussion (article comment threads): title, url, author, latest activity.

params.name: forum
params.description: Forum slug plus numeric id, in the form slug.id, e.g. news-discussion.2

commands.summary: List forum threads with the most recent new posts, from Civis 'What's new > New posts'.
